fact: The article states that after the Diamniadio National Datacenter opened in June 2021, President Macky Sall instructed his government to migrate all state data and digital platforms to it and to repatriate all national data hosted outside Senegal, and that Senegal requires servers to be housed within its borders; the author cites secondary sources and gives no legal instrument.
system: Presidential instruction to host state data in the Diamniadio National Datacenter

fact: Senegal's Presidency confirmed a proposed Cybastion partnership, with $300 million to be mobilised and financing not finalised, that includes a planned sovereign data center to host and manage critical digital systems within Senegal's borders.

Seneweb reports the National Assembly unanimously adopted bill n° 25/2026, which enshrines the principle of keeping data considered sensitive for the State on national territory (127 votes in favour, none against).
